task: Implement the Viết Kudo compose screen (MoMorph screen ihQ26W78P2, file 9ypp4enmFmdK3YAFJLIu6C) at the auth-guarded route /kudos/new, backed by the Supabase local project as the user directed. Replaces the ComingSoon placeholder. Adds the repo's first user-facing write form: INSERT policies, a transactional create function, sender auto-provisioning, Supabase Storage uploads, and a rich-text document model.
acceptanceCriteria: Route /kudos/new is auth-guarded: an unauthenticated visitor is redirected to /login, while an authenticated one gets the form
The public Kudos read surface stays public: /kudos, /kudos/[id] and /kudos/secret-box are unaffected by the new guard
The modal renders the h1 'Gui loi cam on va ghi nhan den dong doi' and the fields in the frame's order: recipient, title, body editor, hashtags, images, anonymous checkbox, footer actions
Recipient autocomplete filters by query, trims whitespace, shows an empty state, and selecting an option fills the field and closes the menu
The Danh hieu title field renders its placeholder and both helper lines and is required
The rich-text toolbar offers bold, italic, strikethrough, ordered list, link and quote, with the link button opening a URL dialog
Typing @ opens a mention menu that narrows as the name continues and inserts the chosen colleague, matching names without diacritics
Hashtags are chips: at least 1 required, at most 5, a sixth is refused with 'Toi da 5 hashtag' while the add button stays visible, and removing one chip leaves the others
Images: a jpg and a png attach and show a thumbnail of that file, a pdf is rejected with a format error, the add button is hidden at 5 and returns after a removal
The anonymous checkbox is unchecked by default and checking it reveals an anonymous name input that hides again when unchecked
Submitting an empty form shows all four required-field errors simultaneously with 'Khong duoc de trong' and does not submit
The submit button is never disabled and instead carries data-submit-ready reflecting whether the required fields are filled
Cancel navigates to /kudos and saves nothing
A successful submit lands on /kudos with the new Kudos visible on the board, proving the row reached Postgres
Every rule is re-validated server-side in the action, so a client that bypasses the UI is still rejected
RLS makes a forged sender impossible: sender_id must resolve through sunners.auth_user_id to the session, and anon cannot insert at all
A signed-in user with no sunners row is auto-provisioned exactly once, idempotently under double submit
The Kudos Live Board renders 'doc' messages as safe React elements and anonymous senders via a dedicated chip, with malformed documents degrading to plain text
F004 does not regress: all 57 seeded rows stay plain and non-anonymous and the shipped board suite stays green
Every screen string ships in both vi and en, compile-time enforced by the Dictionary interface
npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm run build all exit 0, and every new code file stays under the repo's 200-line cap
